svg.title: Decision efficiency, macro-library growth, and cross-task reuse
svg.desc: Language Command (absolute pose targets) is compared with ActionCodec2 tokens (macros reset each round) and ActionCodec2 macros (macros retained and updated). Each condition is an independent four-round chain; circles mark succeeded rounds and x marks failed rounds. Decisions per submission: language 41.2, 45.7, 44.2, 45.8; tokens with macros reset 27.0, 17.2, 19.5, 56.0; tokens with retained macros 17.0, 14.5, 13.7, 8.3. Thinking tokens per submission: language 1,164, 832, 986, 1,092. The retained macro library grows to 6, 9, 12, 13 macros. On a new task, starting from scratch takes 63 decisions and 4,534 thinking tokens and fails; reusing 13 macros takes 16 and 2,853 and succeeds.

g.text: The blue cube is left of center. I
need to map its image position into
the table. Keep the gripper open,
Move the open left gripper toward blue
verified approach macro. Reuse it to
move above blue with the gripper open.
(b) Decision efficiency and macro library growth
